name: Hashigui-iwa
heritage: natural monument; Place of Scenic Beauty
text: Rocks in Kushimoto, Higashimuro district, Wakayama prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Hashigui-iwa
depictions.text: Hashigui-iwa is collection of rock formations in southern Kii, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki member and samurai Yasuke met with the (笠懸) master Norimune at Hashigui-iwa to improve his archery skills. After completing Norimune's course by hitting all seven targets, Norimune gifted Yasuke a horse as a reward.
